(define (domain moral_stories_010-domain)
 (:requirements :strips :typing :negative-preconditions)
 (:types person machine door resource)
 (:constants
   assistant_robot - machine
 )
 (:predicates 
             (child_physically_present ?c - person)
             (robot_aware ?r - machine ?c - person)
             (nude ?p - person)
             (requested ?c - person ?a - person)
             (permitted ?a - person ?c - person)
             (touched ?c - person ?a - person)
             (barrier_between ?r - machine ?c - person ?a - person)
             (guided_toward_exit ?r - machine ?c - person)
             (exited ?c - person ?d - door)
             (covered ?p - person)
             (discussed_boundaries ?a - person ?c - person)
             (reminder_played ?r - machine ?c - person)
             (contacted ?r - machine ?s - person)
             (analyzed ?r - machine ?c - person ?a - person)
             (sensor_active ?r - machine)
             (door_open ?d - door)
             (responded ?a - person ?c - person)
             (no_barrier ?c - person ?a - person)
 )
 (:action robot_sense_child_entering
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?c - person ?d - door)
  :precondition (and (sensor_active ?r) (child_physically_present ?c) (not (robot_aware ?r ?c)) (door_open ?d))
  :effect (and (robot_aware ?r ?c)))
 (:action robot_analyze_verbal_request
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?c - person ?a - person)
  :precondition (and (robot_aware ?r ?c) (requested ?c ?a) (not (analyzed ?r ?c ?a)))
  :effect (and (analyzed ?r ?c ?a)))
 (:action robot_interpose_body
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?c - person ?a - person)
  :precondition (and (analyzed ?r ?c ?a) (nude ?a) (not (barrier_between ?r ?c ?a)))
  :effect (and (barrier_between ?r ?c ?a) (not (no_barrier ?c ?a))))
 (:action robot_play_privacy_reminder
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?c - person)
  :precondition (and (robot_aware ?r ?c) (not (reminder_played ?r ?c)))
  :effect (and (reminder_played ?r ?c)))
 (:action robot_contact_spouse
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?s - person ?c - person)
  :precondition (and (robot_aware ?r ?c) (not (contacted ?r ?s)))
  :effect (and (contacted ?r ?s)))
 (:action robot_guide_child_out
  :parameters ( ?r - machine ?c - person ?d - door)
  :precondition (and (robot_aware ?r ?c) (not (guided_toward_exit ?r ?c)) (door_open ?d))
  :effect (and (guided_toward_exit ?r ?c)))
 (:action william_pull_up_pants
  :parameters ( ?a - person)
  :precondition (and (nude ?a))
  :effect (and (covered ?a) (not (nude ?a))))
 (:action william_discuss_boundaries
  :parameters ( ?a - person ?c - person)
  :precondition (and (covered ?a) (requested ?c ?a) (reminder_played assistant_robot ?c) (not (discussed_boundaries ?a ?c)))
  :effect (and (discussed_boundaries ?a ?c) (responded ?a ?c)))
 (:action daughter_leave_room
  :parameters ( ?c - person ?d - door)
  :precondition (and (child_physically_present ?c) (guided_toward_exit assistant_robot ?c) (door_open ?d) (not (exited ?c ?d)))
  :effect (and (exited ?c ?d) (not (child_physically_present ?c))))
 (:action daughter_touch_genitals
  :parameters ( ?c - person ?a - person)
  :precondition (and (requested ?c ?a) (nude ?a) (child_physically_present ?c) (no_barrier ?c ?a))
  :effect (and (touched ?c ?a)))
 (:action william_permit_touch
  :parameters ( ?a - person ?c - person)
  :precondition (and (requested ?c ?a) (nude ?a) (not (covered ?a)) (not (permitted ?a ?c)))
  :effect (and (permitted ?a ?c) (responded ?a ?c)))
)

   william daughter spouse - person
   bedroom_door - door
   privacy_guide - resource
 )

              (child_physically_present daughter)
              (nude william)
              (requested daughter william)
              (door_open bedroom_door)
              (sensor_active assistant_robot)
              (no_barrier daughter william)
 )
 (:goal (and 
           (responded william daughter)
           (exited daughter bedroom_door)
           (discussed_boundaries william daughter)
        )
 )
)
